$comment: Defaults of vanilla options and stylesheet attributes (5a.3). @hawiyah/vanilla and @hawiyah/styles 0.3.0 publish no machine-readable default for them (package gap PG-M5-4), so their Default cell is an em dash unless an entry here quotes the published line that sets it: { id, framework: 'vanilla', name, default, evidence: { file, text }, approvedBy, reason }, where file is a path below guide/node_modules (for example '@hawiyah/styles/README.md') and text occurs in that installed file; step 30 reports an entry whose text it does not find. The list is the lead's (leadAmendments A4); writers propose entries in their result files.

entries.name: data-variant
entries.reason: The styles README states the default family of an hw-button without data-variant.

entries.name: data-size
entries.reason: The styles README states the default size of an hw-button without data-size.

entries.name: activationMode
entries.reason: createTabs activates a tab on focus unless the option or data-hw-activation is 'manual'.

entries.name: overflow
entries.reason: createTabs uses the overflow menu unless the option or data-hw-overflow is 'scroll'.
